quiFait.valeur: The optician, with a Chrome extension that reads documents and fills in the portal fields
quiFait.detail: Scan of the insurance card and the prescription, then one click on “Remplir” (Fill) in the portal

pec.detail: Pre-fills the identity, social security number (NSS) and prescription details; LPP codes and lens / frame amounts are still entered by hand; Viamedis mapping under development

rejets.detail: Detection of mandatory insurance (AMO) and supplementary insurance (AMC) rejections through the extension, alerts and automatic follow-ups based on rules; correction and resubmission not published

engagement.detail: Pro, Cabinet and Réseau plans can be canceled at any time; Franchise plan on an annual contract

hds.detail: Document reading (OCR) in the store’s browser; tracking metadata stored on the server

plateformes.valeur: 47 portals advertised + Smart Fill on the others
plateformes.detail: Coverage varies by portal: Almerys “Partiel” (Partial), Viamedis “Smart Fill disponible” (Smart Fill available)

citations.texte: Third-party payment automation software, delivered as a Chrome extension and a web dashboard.

No, coverage is partial. OptiBot fills in the policyholder’s social security number, last name, first name, prescription date, request date and RPPS number. LPP codes and lens / frame amounts are still entered by hand since they depend on the equipment sold.
The dedicated Viamedis mapping is under development.
OptiBot automatically detects third-party payment rejections (AMO and AMC) through the Chrome extension, centralizes them in your dashboard, and sends you real-time alerts.
We prefer to be clear: the native connection to the ERP currently exists only for the Optimum family.

meilleurSi: you want to stay in control of every entry and just move faster on the portals
you work on Optimum (LivebyOptimum, AS3.2, Atol Pro), the only natively connected ERP
you want prescription and insurance card images to be read within the store’s browser
you want to test on your own, right away, without a meeting (free trial with no credit card, extension installed the same day)

exclus._pourquoi: no prices on comparison pages; self-reported performance figures are not comparable
exclus.prix: Pro €69.90 excl. VAT/month/seat, Cabinet €179 excl. VAT/month (3 seats), Réseau €299 excl. VAT/month (5 seats, +€30/seat), Franchise on quote from €500 excl. VAT/month; 1-month free trial (optibot-tarifs, optibot-accueil)
exclus.chiffresDeclares: “10 seconds per file”, “47 insurer portals”, “€15,000 of time per year”, ROI “1462%”, “Average rejection rate […] Significantly reduced” (optibot-accueil, optibot-comparatif)
exclus.incoherences: The home page and /pricing advertise a 1-month trial, the /mutuelles/ pages a “7-day free trial”; /comparatif shows “€479/year (Solo plan)” then “€839” for the Pro plan
